basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) is recruiting candidates for 1 Research Associate post on a project-based tenure of 8 Months with an advertisement number of IITI/MATH/RA/01. The position offers a consolidated pay of Rs. 66,500 if the Ph.D. defense is done or Rs. 55,000 if only the Ph.D. thesis is submitted, with the required qualification being a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Mathematics. Eligible candidates can apply by email by submitting a detailed soft copy of their CV and relevant certificates in a single PDF file. The last date to submit applications is 20 October 2026

important_dates.interview_date: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed soft copy of your CV.
Compile all relevant Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth Proof into a single PDF file.
Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] by 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore)
Analysis and Numerics for Stochastic Chemotaxis-Fluid Coupling
Rs. 66,500/- (Consolidated) if Ph.D. defense is done; Rs. 55,000/- (Consolidated) if only Ph.D. thesis is submitted

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the Research Associate position. Those with a strong research background will be given preference as per the desirable criteria.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Mathematics; candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and are awaiting viva/award of degree are also eligible to apply.
rows.desirable_qualification: Strong research background in Stochastic and Numerical Analysis, with at least one Q1 publication.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is for a duration of 8 Months under the ANRF-funded project titled "Analysis and Numerics for Stochastic Chemotaxis-Fluid Coupling". The fellowship is consolidated at Rs. 66,500/- per month if the Ph.D. defense is done, and Rs. 55,000/- per month if only the Ph.D. thesis is submitted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed soft copy of your CV. Compile all relevant Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth Proof into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] by 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the interview. Interviews will be conducted via Google Meet or Zoom. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

rows.date: Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email
